subject: general
question:
M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

O sits to the immediate right of P. Only three people sit between O and Y when counted from the left of O. Only three people sit between P and N when counted from the left of P. W sits to the immediate right of M. How many people sit between X and M when counted from the left of M?
solution:
**Given: **M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. O sits to the immediate right of P.

2. Only three people sit between O and Y when counted from the left of O.

3. Only three people sit between P and N when counted from the left of P.

4. W sits to the immediate right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaefac68e9ed0cce35bdc62f0463d5493c6a84e5336a78b46efe85855807b8cc.png] 

X, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/811d25378208ce3bf3ab9087f16f82b0bfa921f88079510a6f5d637fa7f426c4.png] 

Thus, two people sit between X and M when counted from the left of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
